frame.note: x/z are 0-based grid cells (raw/8192 for actors, raw/32 for Cnet nodes). The sim heightfield frame is this frame shifted by logicOffset in tools/generators/convert.ts — see docs/specs/fcop-viz-handoff.md.

scales.note: Positions/rotations are documented (fcop-logic.md §3). Distance and timing scales are inferred in tools/generators/fcopLogic.ts; raw values are preserved here so a correction touches only the converter.
